## What you did
- Traced Orbitly's ~8% iOS funnel drop to our own kestrel-ios/3.2.0, which sends `event_id` as a per-session counter, so #240's dedupe was discarding distinct events [1].
- Re-keyed dedupe on `(project_id, device_id, event_id)`, keeping replay coverage and a green full test suite [1].

## What changed
- PR #247 is open with @maya-cohen reviewing; she'll approve once CI is green and wants the dropped-event count for Thursday's Orbitly call — your figure is ~1.18M events (8.1% of Orbitly's iOS volume; Zest lost 3,812) [1][2].
- The 12/11 postmortem is final; Noa will present it at Friday's incident review [3].
- Rachel confirmed Zest's dashboards are complete and closed their ticket [6].

## What is still open
- Run the replay from landing for Orbitly (and Zest), 13/11 onward, only after #247 is deployed, then check `ingest_dedupe_dropped_total{project="prj_0rb1"}` stays near zero [1].
- Your Fathom action item: add an alert when the ingest dead-letter queue exceeds 1,000 messages, due before Friday's review [7].
